name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: Generic typed table: sortable columns with aria-sort, optional row selection with a mixed select-all, loading and empty states, and pagination through renderPagination. Sort, selection and page are controlled or not, and agents can sort, select and page it.
docs: Rows are one tab stop: arrows or j/k move, Home/End and PageUp/PageDown jump, Enter calls `onRowOpen(row)`, and with `selectable` Space or x toggles the focused row; a checkbox or button inside a row keeps its own keys. Past 200 rows (`virtualize="auto"`, `estimateSize`, default 41) only the rows in view render, in `tbody` between gap rows, with `aria-rowcount` and `aria-rowindex`, a sticky header and find in page through hidden stubs. Bound its height (`className="max-h-96"`) so it scrolls inside; otherwise it scrolls with the page.
